title: E. coli K12 DNA Extraction
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yrpfv5n
materials: Gently pipet until the cells are resuspended.

steps.title: Grow E. coli culture
steps.instruction: Culture E. coli K12 in BHI broth overnight using 2 mg lyophilized cells in 10 mL BHI broth.

steps.title: Aliquot cell suspension
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the overnight cell suspension to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000–16,000 × g for 2 minutes, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Nuclei Lysis Solution, incubate at 80 °C on a heating block for 5 minutes, then cool to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Nuclei Lysis Solution.

steps.title: Add protein precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution to the lysate and vortex vigorously at high speed for 20 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Protein Precipitation Solution.
Vortex vigorously at high speed for 00:00:20.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase Solution, incubate at 37 °C for 15–60 minutes, then incubate on ice for 5 minutes and finally cool to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase Solution to the cell lysate.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant containing DNA to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube that already contains 600 µL isopropanol; leave any residual supernatant with the protein pellet in the original tube.

steps.title: Pellet DNA (first spin)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000–16,000 × g for 3 minutes, gently invert until thread‑like DNA strands form a visible mass, then centrifuge again at 13,000–16,000 × g for 2 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Gently mix by inversion until thread‑like DNA strands form a visible mass.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully pour off the supernatant and drain the tube on clean absorbent paper.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70 % ethanol, gently invert several times, centrifuge at 13,000–16,000 × g for 2 minutes, drain on clean absorbent paper, and air‑dry for 10–15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL of 70 % ethanol and gently invert the tube several times.
Drain the tube on clean absorbent paper.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNA rehydration solution, then incubate overnight at room temperature or 4 °C.
